python3 -c "
from PIL import Image; import numpy as np, math
im=np.asarray(Image.open('observations/obs_0162.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
R,G,B=im[:,:,0],im[:,:,1],im[:,:,2]
px,py=1.300,7.400   # h=90 east; fw=(1,0) rt=(0,-1)
gb=((B-R)>=4)&(R<200)
def runs(col):
    idx=np.where(col)[0]
    if len(idx)==0: return None
    g=[]; s=idx[0]; p=idx[0]
    for i in idx[1:]:
        if i!=p+1: g.append((int(s),int(p))); s=i
        p=i
    g.append((int(s),int(p))); return g
print('gray runs:')
for u in [240,244,246,248,250,256,300,360,420,480,511]: print(u, runs(gb[:,u]))
print('colours u=400:', [(v,list(im[v,400])) for v in [325,330,332,335,340,341,342,345,400]])
print('tan triangle: floor rows')
tan=(R>120)&(R<200)&((R-B)>10)
for u in [120,150,180,210,240]:
    c=np.where(tan[:,u])[0]
    print(u, (int(c.min()),int(c.max())) if len(c) else None)
D=1.156
print('pred west-face top row for z=1.166:', round(256+(1.55-1.166)*256/D,1))
print('pred base row (off image):', round(256+1.55*256/D,1))
" 2>/dev/null
